Public work

Log Pile

Year
2021
Material
Marine pilings and playground paint (pilings are 12–14 in. in diameter)
Size
30 × 30 × 3 ft overall
Site
Early Learning Center, Wheaton College, Norton, MA
Status
Permanent

A playable outdoor sculpture for the Early Learning Center at Wheaton. The teachers asked for something interactive that would encourage healthy risk taking under supervision and open-ended imaginative play, and it also conforms to playground safety standards in Massachusetts. Scattered pilings, inspired by log jams and driftwood piles, are coated on top in a UV-stable, non-slip rubberized playground paint in moss greens. The green and natural portions meet along a shallow groove that reinforces the paint edge. Low to the ground and weather-resistant, it is meant to be touched, sat on, climbed, balanced on, and jumped off.
